+## Roles × custom providers
+
+A `roles:` chain entry can name a saved `customProviders:` entry **by name** (issue #1552) — the natural hand-written config works instead of silently degrading to a single model:
+
+```yaml
+customProviders:
+  - name: aiai
+    apiType: openai          # the adapter dialect (catalog spec)
+    baseUrl: https://api.bycom.by/v1
+    modelId: glm-4.6
+    keyName: AIAI_API_KEY    # optional: the env/secure-store slot for the key
+
+roles:
+  default:
+    - provider: aiai         # names the entry above
+      model: glm-4.6
+```
+
+Rules:
+
+- **Kind-vs-name**: resolution order is catalog name, then adapter kind (`chatgpt-codex`), then the `customProviders:` registry. Registry entries can never be named after catalog providers (reserved names), so the two namespaces never shadow. An entry known to NEITHER catalog nor registry still skips + degrades exactly as before (the roles config falls back to the single model with one warning — which also prints in the TUI, not only stderr).
+- **Defaults**: the entry supplies `baseUrl` and `keyName` where the chain ref omits them; explicit ref fields always win.
+- **Key slots** (issue #40 precedence): a custom endpoint's key resolves
+  from the entry's pinned `keyName` first, then the endpoint-scoped
+  `FA_KEY_<HOST>` store slot (e.g. `FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY`) or its
+  `_2`/`_3`… rotation stack, and only then falls back to the adapter
+  dialect's catalog env names (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for an `openai` entry —
+  the last-resort fallback, shared with the dialect's default endpoint).
+  Export `AIAI_API_KEY=<key>` (or `/key set FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY <key>`)
+  and every chain entry referencing the entry resolves.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1557
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1557
- **Title**: feat(1552): roles resolve customProviders entries by name
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1552-roles-custom-providers` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +775
- **Deletions**: -26
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T20:46:07Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T21:42:55Z

## PR Description

Closes #1552

## Summary

A roles chain entry naming a `customProviders:` entry (`provider: aiai`) now resolves exactly like the equivalent kind+baseUrl+apiKeyName spelling — the natural hand-written config stops silently degrading to a single model.

### Design (per the GOAL card invariants)

1. **Resolution order** — `ModelRolesResolver._buildEntry`: catalog name/kind first (unchanged, `resolveCliProviderSpec(honorBuildFilter: true)`); on a miss, the custom registry leg: `_findCustomProvider` (case-insensitive name match) → `resolveCliProviderSpec(entry.apiType)` (the entry.spec resolution, honoring the same build filter every user-facing roles surface applies) → `_throughCustomEntry` defaults `baseUrl`/`apiKeyName` from the entry where the ref omits them. **Explicit ref fields always win.**
2. **No collision surface** — reserved-name rule (`isReservedCustomProviderName`) already bars custom entries from catalog names; the registry leg only ever answers what the catalog missed.
3. **gh-760 contract preserved** — a name known to NEITHER catalog nor registry skips with the same named reason and degrades via `UnknownProviderRoleException` exactly as today (newer-version configs keep working across skew).
4. **Key provenance unchanged** (issue #40) — the widened NAME resolution never changes key rules: entry pin → endpoint-scoped `FA_KEY_<HOST>` slot → spec env names, byte-identical to the kind+baseUrl form (REG-2 asserts the forms pick the same slot in all three key layouts).
5. **Boot visibility (AC4)** — the gh-760 roles-drop warning additionally surfaces in the notice stream: `AgentCliConfig.rolesDropNotice` (set by `bin/fah_runapp.dart` alongside the existing stderr line), printed in line mode (`_loadAgentContext`) and re-printed after the TUI banner (`_runTuiRepl` — the alternate screen wipes stderr, the same rule as the third-party-skills hint).

### Wiring

- CLI startup (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`): resolver + `collectRoleSecrets` receive `saved.customProviders`.
- App `AgentService`: `.withEnv` boot maps the live `ProviderRegistry` into `CustomProviderEntry`s (kind ?? openai; no keyName — app keys are session-memory); the `@visibleForTesting` constructor gains the same param so ITs can drive the identical construction.
- `collectRoleSecrets`/`roleKeyNames`/`_refNeedsEndpointSlot` mirror the registry leg so entry-pinned keyNames and endpoint-scoped slots ride the preload set + secrets snapshot (without this, a resolving chain entry would still skip as keyless).
- No config-schema change; existing valid configs without the new form resolve byte-identically (all new params are optional, defaults empty).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — UT-1 (test/model_roles/model_resolver_custom_providers_test.dart): registry resolution, kind+baseUrl equivalence, entry defaults (endpoint slot, entry pin), explicit-ref precedence, case-insensitive match. IT-1 (test/cli/roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart): the user's bycom fixture through the verbatim boot pipeline (secureKeyPreloadNames → preload → collectRoleSecrets → resolver) — all five roles resolve, no skip, for explicit-`apiKeyName`, entry-pin, and endpoint-slot key layouts.
- **AC2** — UT-2: catalog-name + adapter-kind entries resolve identically with a loaded registry (parity against the empty-registry resolver).
- **AC3** — UT-3: unknown-in-both keeps the skip + `UnknownProviderRoleException` degrade; known entries still carry the role past an unknown one.
- **AC4** — line-mode IT prints the configured drop notice through `FakeCliIO`; the TUI re-print mirrors the skills-hint pattern in `_runTuiRepl` (same library seam, no TUI harness in the suite — static, see verification note).
- **AC5** — docs/agents/providers.md «Roles × custom providers»: kind-vs-name rule, FA_KEY_<HOST> key-slot rule, worked yaml example.
- **REG-1** — flutter_app/test/compaction_host_wiring_test.dart UT-2 harness extended: the custom-name form (store providerKind naming a saved entry) resolves like kind+baseUrl on both hosts (`sameResolutionAs`).
- **REG-2** — key provenance: custom-name and kind+baseUrl forms pick the SAME key base in every layout (entry pin / endpoint slot / spec env fallback); entry pin wins over the endpoint slot.

## Verification disclosure (honest)

This lane runs on the shared Mac agent host where the dart VM is SIGKILLed at launch by a machine-level guard (the known fleet condition, exit 137 — confirmed twice this session):

- `dart pub get` in the fresh worktree → **exit 137, zero output**.
- `dart analyze lib/src/model_roles/model_resolver.dart` → **exit 137, zero output**.

Per the lane contract each gate was attempted once, never retried in a loop. **No dart test/analyze output could be produced; the PR's own CI is the real gate.** What was done instead:

- Static 1:1 trace of every new test assertion against the implementation paths (resolution order, key-slot selection per layout, skip-reason text, promote-safe null handling).
- Two real bugs caught and fixed by that static pass before commit: an unseeded fake secure store in the IT helper (store-backed variants would have found nothing), and a nullable access without promotion in the five-role loop.
- All changed files re-read post-edit; all pre-existing callers of the touched functions (`collectRoleSecrets`, `roleKeyNames`, `secureKeyPreloadNames`, `ModelRolesResolver`) checked for signature compatibility — every new parameter is optional with an empty default.
- God-file ceiling respected (largest touched file 2485 lines < 2800); barrel untouched (no new public API surface — the new param/field live on already-exported types).

## Non-goals respected

Custom names in `models:` slots / `/model` resolution, endpoint-scoped key rules, and CLI wizard changes are untouched. The name-resolution shape (entry name → apiType spec → per-entry defaults) leaves room for #1554 to layer per-entry timeout overrides without moving this seam.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

+A `roles:` chain entry can name a saved `customProviders:` entry **by name** (issue #1552) — the natural hand-written config works instead of silently degrading to a single model:

+customProviders:

    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1557
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1557
- **Title**: feat(1552): roles resolve customProviders entries by name
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1552-roles-custom-providers` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +775
- **Deletions**: -26
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T20:46:07Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T21:42:55Z

## PR Description

Closes #1552

## Summary

A roles chain entry naming a `customProviders:` entry (`provider: aiai`) now resolves exactly like the equivalent kind+baseUrl+apiKeyName spelling — the natural hand-written config stops silently degrading to a single model.

### Design (per the GOAL card invariants)

1. **Resolution order** — `ModelRolesResolver._buildEntry`: catalog name/kind first (unchanged, `resolveCliProviderSpec(honorBuildFilter: true)`); on a miss, the custom registry leg: `_findCustomProvider` (case-insensitive name match) → `resolveCliProviderSpec(entry.apiType)` (the entry.spec resolution, honoring the same build filter every user-facing roles surface applies) → `_throughCustomEntry` defaults `baseUrl`/`apiKeyName` from the entry where the ref omits them. **Explicit ref fields always win.**
2. **No collision surface** — reserved-name rule (`isReservedCustomProviderName`) already bars custom entries from catalog names; the registry leg only ever answers what the catalog missed.
3. **gh-760 contract preserved** — a name known to NEITHER catalog nor registry skips with the same named reason and degrades via `UnknownProviderRoleException` exactly as today (newer-version configs keep working across skew).
4. **Key provenance unchanged** (issue #40) — the widened NAME resolution never changes key rules: entry pin → endpoint-scoped `FA_KEY_<HOST>` slot → spec env names, byte-identical to the kind+baseUrl form (REG-2 asserts the forms pick the same slot in all three key layouts).
5. **Boot visibility (AC4)** — the gh-760 roles-drop warning additionally surfaces in the notice stream: `AgentCliConfig.rolesDropNotice` (set by `bin/fah_runapp.dart` alongside the existing stderr line), printed in line mode (`_loadAgentContext`) and re-printed after the TUI banner (`_runTuiRepl` — the alternate screen wipes stderr, the same rule as the third-party-skills hint).

### Wiring

- CLI startup (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`): resolver + `collectRoleSecrets` receive `saved.customProviders`.
- App `AgentService`: `.withEnv` boot maps the live `ProviderRegistry` into `CustomProviderEntry`s (kind ?? openai; no keyName — app keys are session-memory); the `@visibleForTesting` constructor gains the same param so ITs can drive the identical construction.
- `collectRoleSecrets`/`roleKeyNames`/`_refNeedsEndpointSlot` mirror the registry leg so entry-pinned keyNames and endpoint-scoped slots ride the preload set + secrets snapshot (without this, a resolving chain entry would still skip as keyless).
- No config-schema change; existing valid configs without the new form resolve byte-identically (all new params are optional, defaults empty).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — UT-1 (test/model_roles/model_resolver_custom_providers_test.dart): registry resolution, kind+baseUrl equivalence, entry defaults (endpoint slot, entry pin), explicit-ref precedence, case-insensitive match. IT-1 (test/cli/roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart): the user's bycom fixture through the verbatim boot pipeline (secureKeyPreloadNames → preload → collectRoleSecrets → resolver) — all five roles resolve, no skip, for explicit-`apiKeyName`, entry-pin, and endpoint-slot key layouts.
- **AC2** — UT-2: catalog-name + adapter-kind entries resolve identically with a loaded registry (parity against the empty-registry resolver).
- **AC3** — UT-3: unknown-in-both keeps the skip + `UnknownProviderRoleException` degrade; known entries still carry the role past an unknown one.
- **AC4** — line-mode IT prints the configured drop notice through `FakeCliIO`; the TUI re-print mirrors the skills-hint pattern in `_runTuiRepl` (same library seam, no TUI harness in the suite — static, see verification note).
- **AC5** — docs/agents/providers.md «Roles × custom providers»: kind-vs-name rule, FA_KEY_<HOST> key-slot rule, worked yaml example.
- **REG-1** — flutter_app/test/compaction_host_wiring_test.dart UT-2 harness extended: the custom-name form (store providerKind naming a saved entry) resolves like kind+baseUrl on both hosts (`sameResolutionAs`).
- **REG-2** — key provenance: custom-name and kind+baseUrl forms pick the SAME key base in every layout (entry pin / endpoint slot / spec env fallback); entry pin wins over the endpoint slot.

## Verification disclosure (honest)

This lane runs on the shared Mac agent host where the dart VM is SIGKILLed at launch by a machine-level guard (the known fleet condition, exit 137 — confirmed twice this session):

- `dart pub get` in the fresh worktree → **exit 137, zero output**.
- `dart analyze lib/src/model_roles/model_resolver.dart` → **exit 137, zero output**.

Per the lane contract each gate was attempted once, never retried in a loop. **No dart test/analyze output could be produced; the PR's own CI is the real gate.** What was done instead:

- Static 1:1 trace of every new test assertion against the implementation paths (resolution order, key-slot selection per layout, skip-reason text, promote-safe null handling).
- Two real bugs caught and fixed by that static pass before commit: an unseeded fake secure store in the IT helper (store-backed variants would have found nothing), and a nullable access without promotion in the five-role loop.
- All changed files re-read post-edit; all pre-existing callers of the touched functions (`collectRoleSecrets`, `roleKeyNames`, `secureKeyPreloadNames`, `ModelRolesResolver`) checked for signature compatibility — every new parameter is optional with an empty default.
- God-file ceiling respected (largest touched file 2485 lines < 2800); barrel untouched (no new public API surface — the new param/field live on already-exported types).

## Non-goals respected

Custom names in `models:` slots / `/model` resolution, endpoint-scoped key rules, and CLI wizard changes are untouched. The name-resolution shape (entry name → apiType spec → per-entry defaults) leaves room for #1554 to layer per-entry timeout overrides without moving this seam.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

**Error**: `lib/src/model_roles/model_resolver.dart:245:41 — Property 'kind' cannot be accessed on 'ProviderSpec?' because it is potentially null`.

**Root cause**: the #1552 registry leg changed `spec` from a `final` (promote-on-check) to a reassigned `var` (catalog miss → registry-leg reassignment). `spec` is captured by the `buildRouted` closure, and Dart flow analysis never promotes a captured local that is assigned more than once — so the `if (spec == null) return null;` guard stopped covering the `spec.kind` read inside the closure.

**Fix**: bind `final resolvedSpec = spec;` immediately after the early null return (null only ever falls through to the registry leg, then the gh-760 degrade path — exactly the intended semantic) and read the alias in all four downstream uses (`_keyBaseName`, `_missingKeyHint`, `_streamFactory(resolvedSpec.kind)`, `buildCatalogModel(resolvedSpec.name)`). +9/−4, no behavior change.

**Same-class audit over the whole PR diff**: the only other reassigned-nullable-spec read is `startup.dart` `_refNeedsEndpointSlot` (`return spec != null && !sameEndpoint(baseUrl, spec.defaultBaseUrl)`) — that local is NOT captured by any closure, so the inline guard promotes legally. All other nullable values introduced by this PR (`entry`, `resolved`, registry fields) are if-null- or bang-guarded; no other member reads on possibly-null specs exist.

      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)

  static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1538: the publish dry-run below rehearses the tag-stamped

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

# pr-1557: feat(1552): roles resolve customProviders entries by name

## Description

Closes #1552

## Summary

A roles chain entry naming a `customProviders:` entry (`provider: aiai`) now resolves exactly like the equivalent kind+baseUrl+apiKeyName spelling — the natural hand-written config stops silently degrading to a single model.

### Design (per the GOAL card invariants)

1. **Resolution order** — `ModelRolesResolver._buildEntry`: catalog name/kind first (unchanged, `resolveCliProviderSpec(honorBuildFilter: true)`); on a miss, the custom registry leg: `_findCustomProvider` (case-insensitive name match) → `resolveCliProviderSpec(entry.apiType)` (the entry.spec resolution, honoring the same build filter every user-facing roles surface applies) → `_throughCustomEntry` defaults `baseUrl`/`apiKeyName` from the entry where the ref omits them. **Explicit ref fields always win.**
2. **No collision surface** — reserved-name rule (`isReservedCustomProviderName`) already bars custom entries from catalog names; the registry leg only ever answers what the catalog missed.
3. **gh-760 contract preserved** — a name known to NEITHER catalog nor registry skips with the same named reason and degrades via `UnknownProviderRoleException` exactly as today (newer-version configs keep working across skew).
4. **Key provenance unchanged** (issue #40) — the widened NAME resolution never changes key rules: entry pin → endpoint-scoped `FA_KEY_<HOST>` slot → spec env names, byte-identical to the kind+baseUrl form (REG-2 asserts the forms pick the same slot in all three key layouts).
5. **Boot visibility (AC4)** — the gh-760 roles-drop warning additionally surfaces in the notice stream: `AgentCliConfig.rolesDropNotice` (set by `bin/fah_runapp.dart` alongside the existing stderr line), printed in line mode (`_loadAgentContext`) and re-printed after the TUI banner (`_runTuiRepl` — the alternate screen wipes stderr, the same rule as the third-party-skills hint).

### Wiring

- CLI startup (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`): resolver + `collectRoleSecrets` receive `saved.customProviders`.
- App `AgentService`: `.withEnv` boot maps the live `ProviderRegistry` into `CustomProviderEntry`s (kind ?? openai; no keyName — app keys are session-memory); the `@visibleForTesting` constructor gains the same param so ITs can drive the identical construction.
- `collectRoleSecrets`/`roleKeyNames`/`_refNeedsEndpointSlot` mirror the registry leg so entry-pinned keyNames and endpoint-scoped slots ride the preload set + secrets snapshot (without this, a resolving chain entry would still skip as keyless).
- No config-schema change; existing valid configs without the new form resolve byte-identically (all new params are optional, defaults empty).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — UT-1 (test/model_roles/model_resolver_custom_providers_test.dart): registry resolution, kind+baseUrl equivalence, entry defaults (endpoint slot, entry pin), explicit-ref precedence, case-insensitive match. IT-1 (test/cli/roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart): the user's bycom fixture through the verbatim boot pipeline (secureKeyPreloadNames → preload → collectRoleSecrets → resolver) — all five roles resolve, no skip, for explicit-`apiKeyName`, entry-pin, and endpoint-slot key layouts.
- **AC2** — UT-2: catalog-name + adapter-kind entries resolve identically with a loaded registry (parity against the empty-registry resolver).
- **AC3** — UT-3: unknown-in-both keeps the skip + `UnknownProviderRoleException` degrade; known entries still carry the role past an unknown one.
- **AC4** — line-mode IT prints the configured drop notice through `FakeCliIO`; the TUI re-print mirrors the skills-hint pattern in `_runTuiRepl` (same library seam, no TUI harness in the suite — static, see verification note).
- **AC5** — docs/agents/providers.md «Roles × custom providers»: kind-vs-name rule, FA_KEY_<HOST> key-slot rule, worked yaml example.
- **REG-1** — flutter_app/test/compaction_host_wiring_test.dart UT-2 harness extended: the custom-name form (store providerKind naming a saved entry) resolves like kind+baseUrl on both hosts (`sameResolutionAs`).
- **REG-2** — key provenance: custom-name and kind+baseUrl forms pick the SAME key base in every layout (entry pin / endpoint slot / spec env fallback); entry pin wins over the endpoint slot.

## Verification disclosure (honest)

This lane runs on the shared Mac agent host where the dart VM is SIGKILLed at launch by a machine-level guard (the known fleet condition, exit 137 — confirmed twice this session):

- `dart pub get` in the fresh worktree → **exit 137, zero output**.
- `dart analyze lib/src/model_roles/model_resolver.dart` → **exit 137, zero output**.

Per the lane contract each gate was attempted once, never retried in a loop. **No dart test/analyze output could be produced; the PR's own CI is the real gate.** What was done instead:

- Static 1:1 trace of every new test assertion against the implementation paths (resolution order, key-slot selection per layout, skip-reason text, promote-safe null handling).
- Two real bugs caught and fixed by that static pass before commit: an unseeded fake secure store in the IT helper (store-backed variants would have found nothing), and a nullable access without promotion in the five-role loop.
- All changed files re-read post-edit; all pre-existing callers of the touched functions (`collectRoleSecrets`, `roleKeyNames`, `secureKeyPreloadNames`, `ModelRolesResolver`) checked for signature compatibility — every new parameter is optional with an empty default.
- God-file ceiling respected (largest touched file 2485 lines < 2800); barrel untouched (no new public API surface — the new param/field live on already-exported types).

## Non-goals respected

Custom names in `models:` slots / `/model` resolution, endpoint-scoped key rules, and CLI wizard changes are untouched. The name-resolution shape (entry name → apiType spec → per-entry defaults) leaves room for #1554 to layer per-entry timeout overrides without moving this seam.

+## Roles × custom providers
+
+A `roles:` chain entry can name a saved `customProviders:` entry **by name** (issue #1552) — the natural hand-written config works instead of silently degrading to a single model:
+
+```yaml
+customProviders:
+  - name: aiai
+    apiType: openai          # the adapter dialect (catalog spec)
+    baseUrl: https://api.bycom.by/v1
+    modelId: glm-4.6
+    keyName: AIAI_API_KEY    # optional: the env/secure-store slot for the key
+

+  default:
+    - provider: aiai         # names the entry above

+```
+
+Rules:
+
+- **Kind-vs-name**: resolution order is catalog name, then adapter kind (`chatgpt-codex`), then the `customProviders:` registry. Registry entries can never be named after catalog providers (reserved names), so the two namespaces never shadow. An entry known to NEITHER catalog nor registry still skips + degrades exactly as before (the roles config falls back to the single model with one warning — which also prints in the TUI, not only stderr).
+- **Defaults**: the entry supplies `baseUrl` and `keyName` where the chain ref omits them; explicit ref fields always win.
+- **Key slots** (issue #40 precedence): a custom endpoint's key resolves
+  from the entry's pinned `keyName` first, then the endpoint-scoped
+  `FA_KEY_<HOST>` store slot (e.g. `FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY`) or its
+  `_2`/`_3`… rotation stack, and only then falls back to the adapter
+  dialect's catalog env names (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for an `openai` entry —
+  the last-resort fallback, shared with the dialect's default endpoint).
+  Export `AIAI_API_KEY=<key>` (or `/key set FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY <key>`)
+  and every chain entry referencing the entry resolves.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# gh-1059 AC4: the real-keychain runner guard — `security`
      # add/find/delete against the runner's login keychain through the
      # bounded-helper machinery (outcome classification incl. stderr
      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`
      # (real side effects), so the Linux core shards and the pre-commit
      # gate skip it; this macOS leg is where it actually executes. Skips
      # with a named reason when no `security` binary / default keychain.
      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)
        run: dart test test/secrets/secure_key_store_test.dart --tags integration

  static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1538: the publish dry-run below rehearses the tag-stamped
          # stage (gh-1522), moved here from the retired nightly
          # full-quality leg — tag math needs the full tag graph
          # (blobless per gh-1477, same incantation that leg used).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

{
  "key": "pr-1557",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "feat(1552): roles resolve customProviders entries by name",
    "description": "Closes #1552

## Summary

A roles chain entry naming a `customProviders:` entry (`provider: aiai`) now resolves exactly like the equivalent kind+baseUrl+apiKeyName spelling — the natural hand-written config stops silently degrading to a single model.

### Design (per the GOAL card invariants)

1. **Resolution order** — `ModelRolesResolver._buildEntry`: catalog name/kind first (unchanged, `resolveCliProviderSpec(honorBuildFilter: true)`); on a miss, the custom registry leg: `_findCustomProvider` (case-insensitive name match) → `resolveCliProviderSpec(entry.apiType)` (the entry.spec resolution, honoring the same build filter every user-facing roles surface applies) → `_throughCustomEntry` defaults `baseUrl`/`apiKeyName` from the entry where the ref omits them. **Explicit ref fields always win.**
2. **No collision surface** — reserved-name rule (`isReservedCustomProviderName`) already bars custom entries from catalog names; the registry leg only ever answers what the catalog missed.
3. **gh-760 contract preserved** — a name known to NEITHER catalog nor registry skips with the same named reason and degrades via `UnknownProviderRoleException` exactly as today (newer-version configs keep working across skew).
4. **Key provenance unchanged** (issue #40) — the widened NAME resolution never changes key rules: entry pin → endpoint-scoped `FA_KEY_<HOST>` slot → spec env names, byte-identical to the kind+baseUrl form (REG-2 asserts the forms pick the same slot in all three key layouts).
5. **Boot visibility (AC4)** — the gh-760 roles-drop warning additionally surfaces in the notice stream: `AgentCliConfig.rolesDropNotice` (set by `bin/fah_runapp.dart` alongside the existing stderr line), printed in line mode (`_loadAgentContext`) and re-printed after the TUI banner (`_runTuiRepl` — the alternate screen wipes stderr, the same rule as the third-party-skills hint).

### Wiring

- CLI startup (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`): resolver + `collectRoleSecrets` receive `saved.customProviders`.
- App `AgentService`: `.withEnv` boot maps the live `ProviderRegistry` into `CustomProviderEntry`s (kind ?? openai; no keyName — app keys are session-memory); the `@visibleForTesting` constructor gains the same param so ITs can drive the identical construction.
- `collectRoleSecrets`/`roleKeyNames`/`_refNeedsEndpointSlot` mirror the registry leg so entry-pinned keyNames and endpoint-scoped slots ride the preload set + secrets snapshot (without this, a resolving chain entry would still skip as keyless).
- No config-schema change; existing valid configs without the new form resolve byte-identically (all new params are optional, defaults empty).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — UT-1 (test/model_roles/model_resolver_custom_providers_test.dart): registry resolution, kind+baseUrl equivalence, entry defaults (endpoint slot, entry pin), explicit-ref precedence, case-insensitive match. # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

+## Roles × custom providers
+
+A `roles:` chain entry can name a saved `customProviders:` entry **by name** (issue #1552) — the natural hand-written config works instead of silently degrading to a single model:
+
+```yaml
+customProviders:
+  - name: aiai
+    apiType: openai          # the adapter dialect (catalog spec)
+    baseUrl: https://api.bycom.by/v1
+    modelId: glm-4.6
+    keyName: AIAI_API_KEY    # optional: the env/secure-store slot for the key
+
+roles:
+  default:
+    - provider: aiai         # names the entry above
+      model: glm-4.6
+```
+
+Rules:
+
+- **Kind-vs-name**: resolution order is catalog name, then adapter kind (`chatgpt-codex`), then the `customProviders:` registry. Registry entries can never be named after catalog providers (reserved names), so the two namespaces never shadow. An entry known to NEITHER catalog nor registry still skips + degrades exactly as before (the roles config falls back to the single model with one warning — which also prints in the TUI, not only stderr).
+- **Defaults**: the entry supplies `baseUrl` and `keyName` where the chain ref omits them; explicit ref fields always win.
+- **Key slots** (issue #40 precedence): a custom endpoint's key resolves
+  from the entry's pinned `keyName` first, then the endpoint-scoped
+  `FA_KEY_<HOST>` store slot (e.g. `FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY`) or its
+  `_2`/`_3`… rotation stack, and only then falls back to the adapter
+  dialect's catalog env names (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for an `openai` entry —
+  the last-resort fallback, shared with the dialect's default endpoint).
+  Export `AIAI_API_KEY=<key>` (or `/key set FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY <key>`)
+  and every chain entry referencing the entry resolves.
+

3. **gh-760 contract preserved** — a name known to NEITHER catalog nor registry skips with the same named reason and degrades via `UnknownProviderRoleException` exactly as today (newer-version configs keep working across skew).
4. **Key provenance unchanged** (issue #40) — the widened NAME resolution never changes key rules: entry pin → endpoint-scoped `FA_KEY_<HOST>` slot → spec env names, byte-identical to the kind+baseUrl form (REG-2 asserts the forms pick the same slot in all three key layouts).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs

+## Roles × custom providers
+
+A `roles:` chain entry can name a saved `customProviders:` entry **by name** (issue #1552) — the natural hand-written config works instead of silently degrading to a single model:
+
+```yaml
+customProviders:
+  - name: aiai
+    apiType: openai          # the adapter dialect (catalog spec)
+    baseUrl: https://api.bycom.by/v1
+    modelId: glm-4.6
+    keyName: AIAI_API_KEY    # optional: the env/secure-store slot for the key
+
+roles:
+  default:
+    - provider: aiai         # names the entry above
+      model: glm-4.6
+```
+
+Rules:
+
+- **Kind-vs-name**: resolution order is catalog name, then adapter kind (`chatgpt-codex`), then the `customProviders:` registry. Registry entries can never be named after catalog providers (reserved names), so the two namespaces never shadow. An entry known to NEITHER catalog nor registry still skips + degrades exactly as before (the roles config falls back to the single model with one warning — which also prints in the TUI, not only stderr).
+- **Defaults**: the entry supplies `baseUrl` and `keyName` where the chain ref omits them; explicit ref fields always win.
+- **Key slots** (issue #40 precedence): a custom endpoint's key resolves
+  from the entry's pinned `keyName` first, then the endpoint-scoped
+  `FA_KEY_<HOST>` store slot (e.g. `FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY`) or its
+  `_2`/`_3`… rotation stack, and only then falls back to the adapter
+  dialect's catalog env names (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for an `openai` entry —
+  the last-resort fallback, shared with the dialect's default endpoint).
+  Export `AIAI_API_KEY=<key>` (or `/key set FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY <key>`)
+  and every chain entry referencing the entry resolves.
+

      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done

          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null

            exit 1
          fi

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# gh-1059 AC4: the real-keychain runner guard — `security`
      # add/find/delete against the runner's login keychain through the
      # bounded-helper machinery (outcome classification incl. stderr
      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`
      # (real side effects), so the Linux core shards and the pre-commit
      # gate skip it; this macOS leg is where it actually executes. Skips
      # with a named reason when no `security` binary / default keychain.
      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)
        run: dart test test/secrets/secure_key_store_test.dart --tags integration

  static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1538: the publish dry-run below rehearses the tag-stamped
          # stage (gh-1522), moved here from the retired nightly
          # full-quality leg — tag math needs the full tag graph
          # (blobless per gh-1477, same incantation that leg used).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"

{
  "key": "pr-1557",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "feat(1552): roles resolve customProviders entries by name",
    "description": "Closes #1552

## Summary

A roles chain entry naming a `customProviders:` entry (`provider: aiai`) now resolves exactly like the equivalent kind+baseUrl+apiKeyName spelling — the natural hand-written config stops silently degrading to a single model.

### Design (per the GOAL card invariants)

1. **Resolution order** — `ModelRolesResolver._buildEntry`: catalog name/kind first (unchanged, `resolveCliProviderSpec(honorBuildFilter: true)`); on a miss, the custom registry leg: `_findCustomProvider` (case-insensitive name match) → `resolveCliProviderSpec(entry.apiType)` (the entry.spec resolution, honoring the same build filter every user-facing roles surface applies) → `_throughCustomEntry` defaults `baseUrl`/`apiKeyName` from the entry where the ref omits them. **Explicit ref fields always win.**
2. **No collision surface** — reserved-name rule (`isReservedCustomProviderName`) already bars custom entries from catalog names; the registry leg only ever answers what the catalog missed.
3. **gh-760 contract preserved** — a name known to NEITHER catalog nor registry skips with the same named reason and degrades via `UnknownProviderRoleException` exactly as today (newer-version configs keep working across skew).
4. **Key provenance unchanged** (issue #40) — the widened NAME resolution never changes key rules: entry pin → endpoint-scoped `FA_KEY_<HOST>` slot → spec env names, byte-identical to the kind+baseUrl form (REG-2 asserts the forms pick the same slot in all three key layouts).
5. **Boot visibility (AC4)** — the gh-760 roles-drop warning additionally surfaces in the notice stream: `AgentCliConfig.rolesDropNotice` (set by `bin/fah_runapp.dart` alongside the existing stderr line), printed in line mode (`_loadAgentContext`) and re-printed after the TUI banner (`_runTuiRepl` — the alternate screen wipes stderr, the same rule as the third-party-skills hint).

### Wiring

- CLI startup (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`): resolver + `collectRoleSecrets` receive `saved.customProviders`.
- App `AgentService`: `.withEnv` boot maps the live `ProviderRegistry` into `CustomProviderEntry`s (kind ?? openai; no keyName — app keys are session-memory); the `@visibleForTesting` constructor gains the same param so ITs can drive the identical construction.
- `collectRoleSecrets`/`roleKeyNames`/`_refNeedsEndpointSlot` mirror the registry leg so entry-pinned keyNames and endpoint-scoped slots ride the preload set + secrets snapshot (without this, a resolving chain entry would still skip as keyless).
- No config-schema change; existing valid configs without the new form resolve byte-identically (all new params are optional, defaults empty).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — UT-1 (test/model_roles/model_resolver_custom_providers_test.dart): registry resolution, kind+baseUrl equivalence, entry defaults (endpoint slot, entry pin), explicit-ref precedence, case-insensitive match. IT-1 (test/cli/roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart): the user's bycom fixture through the verbatim boot pipeline (secureKeyPreloadNames → preload → collectRoleSecrets → resolver) — all five roles resolve, no skip, for explicit-`apiKeyName`, entry-pin, and endpoint-slot key layouts.
- **AC2** — UT-2: catalog-name + adapter-kind entries resolve identically with a loaded registry (parity against the empty-registry resolver).
- **AC3** — UT-3: unknown-in-both keeps the skip + `UnknownProviderRoleException` degrade; known entries still carry the role past an unknown one.
- **AC4** — line-mode IT prints the configured drop notice through `FakeCliIO`; the TUI re-print mirrors the skills-hint pattern in `_runTuiRepl` (same library seam, no TUI harness in the suite — static, see verification note).
- **AC5** — docs/agents/providers.md «Roles × custom providers»: kind-vs-name rule, FA_KEY_<HOST> key-slot rule, worked yaml example.
- **REG-1** — flutter_app/test/compaction_host_wiring_test.dart UT-2 harness extended: the custom-name form (store providerKind naming a saved entry) resolves like kind+baseUrl on both hosts (`sameResolutionAs`).
- **REG-2** — key provenance: custom-name and kind+baseUrl forms pick the SAME key base in every layout (entry pin / endpoint slot / spec env fallback); entry pin wins over the endpoint slot.

## Verification disclosure (honest)

This lane runs on the shared Mac agent host where the dart VM is SIGKILLed at launch by a machine-level guard (the known fleet condition, exit 137 — confirmed twice this session):

- `dart pub get` in the fresh worktree → **exit 137, zero output**.
- `dart analyze lib/src/model_roles/model_resolver.dart` → **exit 137, zero output**.

Per the lane contract each gate was attempted once, never retried in a loop. **No dart test/analyze output could be produced; the PR's own CI is the real gate.** What was done instead:

- Static 1:1 trace of every new test assertion against the implementation paths (resolution order, key-slot selection per layout, skip-reason text, promote-safe null handling).
- Two real bugs caught and fixed by that static pass before commit: an unseeded fake secure store in the IT helper (store-backed variants would have found nothing), and a nullable access without promotion in the five-role loop.
- All changed files re-read post-edit; all pre-existing callers of the touched functions (`collectRoleSecrets`, `roleKeyNames`, `secureKeyPreloadNames`, `ModelRolesResolver`) checked for signature compatibility — every new parameter is optional with an empty default.
- God-file ceiling respected (largest touched file 2485 lines < 2800); barrel untouched (no new public API surface — the new param/field live on already-exported types).

## Non-goals respected

Custom names in `models:` slots / `/model` resolution, endpoint-scoped key rules, and CLI wizard changes are untouched. The name-resolution shape (entry name → apiType spec → per-entry defaults) leaves room for #1554 to layer per-entry timeout overrides without moving this seam."

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

An entry known to NEITHER catalog nor registry still skips + degrades exactly as before (the roles config falls back to the single model with one warning — which also prints in the TUI, not only stderr).
+- **Defaults**: the entry supplies `baseUrl` and `keyName` where the chain ref omits them; explicit ref fields always win.
+- **Key slots** (issue #40 precedence): a custom endpoint's key resolves
+  from the entry's pinned `keyName` first, then the endpoint-scoped
+  `FA_KEY_<HOST>` store slot (e.g. `FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY`) or its
+  `_2`/`_3`… rotation stack, and only then falls back to the adapter
+  dialect's catalog env names (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for an `openai` entry —
+  the last-resort fallback, shared with the dialect's default endpoint).
+  Export `AIAI_API_KEY=<key>` (or `/key set FA_KEY_API_BYCOM_BY <key>`)
+  and every chain entry referencing the entry resolves.
+

# gh-1059 AC4: the real-keychain runner guard — `security`
      # add/find/delete against the runner's login keychain through the
      # bounded-helper machinery (outcome classification incl. stderr
      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`
      # (real side effects), so the Linux core shards and the pre-commit
      # gate skip it; this macOS leg is where it actually executes. Skips
      # with a named reason when no `security` binary / default keychain.
      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)
        run: dart test test/secrets/secure_key_store_test.dart --tags integration

  static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1538: the publish dry-run below rehearses the tag-stamped
          # stage (gh-1522), moved here from the retired nightly
          # full-quality leg — tag math needs the full tag graph
          # (blobless per gh-1477, same incantation that leg used).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
